content: ASD-STE100 Issue 9 (January 2025): 53 writing rules plus roughly 900 approved words; next issue due January 2028. Copyright is fully owned by ASD/STEMG - asd-ste100.org carries '(c) Copyright 2026 STEMG - All Rights Reserved', the PDF is free but gated behind a request form, and NO open-source licence text is published anywhere. The asd-europe.org FAQ calls it 'an open-source standard and free to download', which contradicts the All-Rights-Reserved notice; 'open' there plainly means openly available, not OSI-licensed. Redistribution/embedding rights for the dictionary are UNKNOWN - verify (only STEMG can answer, stemg@asd-ste100.org). ASD-STE100 is a registered EU trademark No. 017966390 and ASD does not endorse tools claiming 'full compliance'. Checkers are commercial (Boeing BSEC, Congree, HyperSTE, MAXit, Oxygen Terminology Checker, R4i, Reqchecker); no open-source checker found. Prior art (nuelcyoung/asd-ste100, danyuchn/asd-ste100-skill) deliberately paraphrases the rules, does NOT redistribute the dictionary, links to the official download, and ships a non-affiliation disclaimer.
